summary.text: Keenan Gentry is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 30B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Chad Westberg in a race with no incumbent.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran and truck driver, he lists gun law changes, health care and education funding among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Keenan Gentry earned a high school diploma from Springtown High School, served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2007 to 2011, and has worked as a truck driver.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Gentry described himself as a husband, father of two, Marine Corps veteran and truck driver of nearly ten years.
He said his campaign priorities are stricter gun laws, making health care more affordable, and raising teacher pay and school funding.
